name: How long does ADU zoning coordination typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does ADU zoning coordination typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for ADU zoning coordination can vary based on the complexity of the project and the specific city's review processes. Generally, initial assessment and preliminary coordination might take a few weeks. The official city review process for zoning compliance can range from several weeks to a few months, depending on departmental workload, the completeness of the submission, and whether revisions are required. Proactive engagement and thorough preparation can help expedite this phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU zoning coordination typically takes from several weeks to a few months, depending on project complexity and city review times.
